preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10^4.
The number of elements in the array is between 1 and 10^4.
Each element of the array is a positive integer between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 10^4.
preconditions.description: The total number of elements across all test cases does not exceed 10^4.

postconditions.expression: Output is either -1 or a sequence of operations.
postconditions.description: The output should indicate whether a sequence of operations exists that makes all elements of the array equal. If it does, the sequence should be provided.

postconditions.expression: If output is a sequence of operations, the number of operations is no more than 3n.
postconditions.description: The number of operations in the sequence should not exceed 3 times the number of elements in the array.

postconditions.expression: All elements of the array are non-negative after each operation.
postconditions.description: The array elements must remain non-negative throughout the sequence of operations.

postconditions.expression: If output is a sequence of operations, all elements of the array are equal after the last operation.
postconditions.description: If a sequence of operations is provided, all elements of the array should be equal after the last operation in the sequence.
